Subject: Aligning commit windows, PO handoff, and invoice sequencing — timeline before month-end

Team / Lisa —

Quick note ahead of the month-end: Acme's procurement timeline is starting to compress and we need to lock the PO handoff and invoice sequencing so bookings can be recognized in November. Key asks below so we have a clear path for Finance.

1) Stage updates in HubSpot: please move the opportunity to "Commit - PO inbound" as soon as you get verbal approval. That state triggers our dedicated billing workflow.
2) PO ETA: Lisa, can you confirm the target date the PO will land in AP? If it's before 11/24 we can route invoices for recognition this month.
3) Invoice sequencing: we have two invoices planned (50% upfront / 50% on activation). If PO requires a single consolidated invoice, we need to know now to adjust revenue recognition timing.
4) Contingency: if PO arrives after 11/24, Finance needs an explicit sign-off to treat booking as Dec recognition; otherwise we'll proceed with the November close.

I've attached a lightweight PO template and a proposed invoice schedule for Acme to review. Marissa / Laura — can you confirm HubSpot stage and whether any legal gating (SOW redlines) will delay the PO?

Target: finalize routing and internal approvals by EOD 18 Nov so Finance can queue invoices.

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Acme_PO_template_fillable.pdf (application/pdf), proposed-invoice-schedule.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

- Legal: SOW was signed last week; no redlines pending.

Gap: I don't yet have the formal PO ETA from Procurement. Lisa, if they can confirm a target date we can lock the invoice dates. If they prefer a single consolidated invoice, we need to know for revenue treatment.

I'll follow up directly with Procurement and loop Finance if needed.

Marissa
